items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1960-09-16
items.q: And Sonny Henry gave me a few lessons too.

ctx.x: With him. You know I never got to meet him. I was always going to even the day or the week that he died. I had written down on a piece of paper. I was going to go by and try to see him. And I heard suddenly he died. I knew he'd been sick. One of the best. Him and Sonny. Can you tell us more about Vic? What kind of lessons he gave you? I mean what kind of a book he taught and everything that you can remember about him? He taught the white excelsior. The white excelsior? The excelsior book. I have an old mandolin…
With Vic Gaspar. Mm-hmm. And Sonny Henry gave me a few lessons too. You did hear? Sonny Henry. Yeah. And Yank Johnson. Who was that? I've heard of him.
I never got to hear him. And Buddy Johnson.

items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1963-11-11
items.q: He gave me a few lessons too.

ctx.x: So, you say Sonny Henry gave you a few lessons too?
He gave me a few lessons too. Uh-huh. Who was he playing with at that time? Sonny Henry? Yeah.
He used to play with the Tuxedo's brass band at that time. Yeah. Yeah. He used to play with the Tuxedo's brass band at that time.
